lines.text: Twenty minutes after the incident, the Central Government informed the Ark's citizens of the invasion and urged them to evacuate and seek shelter.
-> Thanks to the Central Government's rapid response time, citizens were all evacuated to the safety shelters in time.

lines.speaker: FB
lines.text: No need to specify time. Conveying that the response was swift is sufficient.
Pointing out how Central Government advised citizens is unnecessary: changed to "citizens were evacuated".
